editorial.blurb: Authentic Mexican cooking with hand-made tortillas and housemade salsas, where the kitchen shines brightest when orders are executed with care.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the al pastor tacos and chilaquiles with cecina—reviewers rave about these dishes. Ask your server to double-check your order before leaving the kitchen, as execution can be inconsistent.

topDishes.note: Praised as superior even to competitors, with amazing sauces
Well-cooked chips that stay crunchy throughout, flavorful and spicy
Delicious and thoughtfully served as complimentary soup with chips
